SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.engineering.pid

Class PidSeparatorControlStudy

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.pid.PidSeparatorControlStudy
public final class PidSeparatorControlStudy extends Object
Runs a revision-bound, instrumented separator pressure/level control acceptance study.

The study resolves actual P&ID bindings on an isolated process copy, applies declared US-Cv candidates, ramps the physical inlet boundary and records one deterministic sample per accepted physical step. Response criteria and the separator's explicit cumulative-energy policy remain separate. A passing result is simulation evidence for the declared case only; it does not infer SIL/IPL credit, vendor valve performance, hazard completeness, standards conformance or construction approval.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa
